blocks.text: Breakup rumors surrounding Arjo Atayde and Maine Mendoza were once again debunked after the celebrity couple were seen together with the actor’s family, celebrating his 36th birthday. The actor-politician spent quality time with Mendoza and the Atayde family over dinner earlier this month, as seen in the photos shared by his actress mom Sylvia Sanchez on her Instagram page on Wednesday, Nov. 18. “Belated happy birthday, Arjo! I love you so much, nak!” Sanchez wrote in the caption. The post includes a video showing Arjo blowing out his birthday candles while surrounded by Mendoza, Sanchez, his dad Art Atayde, and siblings […]...
